description: Records where the signed-in user was over a range of past days, so their history stops assuming. Use it when the user corrects a stretch — get_my_history marks inherited days with `locationAssumed`, and the history calendar offers those stretches for correction. Pass a cityId from search_city, or lat/lon. Changes only the location: whether they went outside that day is untouched. Requires OAuth (scope history:write).

from.description: First day of the stretch, YYYY-MM-DD

lat.description: Latitude, for a place not in the database

to.description: Last day of the stretch, YYYY-MM-DD; same as `from` for one day

name: set_history_location
